label: Naive CD8 T cells
description: Cluster 0 is a naive CD8 T cell population: M69 (naive CD8 T markers, TCF7, LEF1, CCR7, SELL, IL7R, CD8A) carries 17% of counts and is present in ~98% of cells with 63x enrichment, supported by top genes TCF7, LEF1, CD8A, CCR7, SATB1, THEMIS and KLRK1. Pan-T (M61) and T cell (M32) factors add lineage support with modest shares. Diffuse housekeeping/background metagenes (M0, M24, M18, M38, M51, M60, M68) are low-specificity and not a distinct lineage; no myeloid or B contamination is evident, and the CD248/FCGBP genes are minor.
cell_types: Naive CD8 T cells
metagene_label: Naive CD8 T cell markers + Diffuse nuclear housekeeping background

label: Naive T cells
description: Cluster 1 is a large (3.7% of cells) naive T-cell cluster. Its identity rests on several T-lineage metagenes: M42 (pan-T TRBC1/TRAC/CD3E/CD3D/CD3G/CD2/LCK, high confidence), M61 (pan-T TRAC/CD3E/CD2/TCF7), M52 and M64 (naive T program TCF7/LEF1/CCR7/SELL/LTB/BCL11B), and M66 (naive CD4-like IL7R/LEF1/CCR7/CD4). The top genes match: TRBC1, TCF7, TRAC, CCR7, SATB1, LEF1, BCL11B. Cytotoxic and CD8 markers are absent, and no myeloid or B-cell signal appears. Diffuse background metagenes (M0, M24, M78, M83) carry little identity. The cluster most likely consists of naive T cells, with CD4 and CD8 not clearly separated.
cell_types: Naive T cells, Naive CD4 T cells
metagene_label: Diffuse nuclear housekeeping background + Naive T cell markers

label: Naive T cells (CD4-leaning)
description: Cluster 2 is a large, quiescent T-cell cluster: naive-T metagenes M52, M66, M75, M64, M56 and M79 (TCF7, LEF1, CCR7, SELL, IL7R, LTB, BCL11B, CD4) and pan-T metagenes M61, M19, M32 (TRAC, CD3E/D/G, CD2, TRBC2) carry the identity, and top genes TCF7, IL7R, LEF1, CCR7, SATB1, BCL11B confirm it. Naive CD4 signal (M66, M79) is present but the cluster is not clearly CD4-restricted; cytotoxic CD8 markers are absent. Diffuse background (M0, M24) and a glucocorticoid/stress program (M9) add noise without defining identity. No meaningful foreign lineage contamination is evident.
cell_types: Naive CD4 T cells, Naive T cells
metagene_label: Diffuse nuclear housekeeping background + Naive T cell markers

label: Naive T cells (CD4-leaning)
description: Cluster 3 is a large naive T-cell population. Naive T-cell metagenes dominate (M52 5.7x, M66 naive CD4 6.1x, M64, M56, M75, M79 naive CD4, plus T-lineage M67, M32, M54), and top genes TCF7, LEF1, CCR7, BCL11B, SATB1, DGKA, MAL, FHIT and ITPKB are enriched. The largest share is M0, a diffuse nuclear housekeeping background in 38% of cells, with no lineage signal, so it is not identity. Naive CD4 signals (M66, M79, IL7R, CD4, FCMR) are present, but the cluster is best called naive T cells, with a CD4 lean. EGR1/IEG signal (M21) is minor and likely dissociation-related.
cell_types: Naive CD4 T cells, Naive T cells
metagene_label: Diffuse nuclear housekeeping background + Naive T cell markers

label: Naive T cells (interferon-stimulated)
description: Cluster of naive T cells with a type I interferon-stimulated signature. Naive T identity comes from several metagenes: M66 (naive CD4, 4.3x enriched), M64, M52, M56, M75 and M61 (pan-T), supported by TCF7, LEF1, CCR7, IL7R, LTB and BCL11B among the top genes. The interferon program (M57, 11.6x enriched, IFI44, IFI6, OAS3, MX1, ISG15) is strongly enriched but present in only about 7% of cells, so it qualifies a subset rather than defining the cluster. M99 (IFN-gamma) adds little. No clear foreign lineage contamination; M0 is diffuse background. CD4 versus CD8 cannot be fully resolved, though CD4-leaning M66 and M79 are favored.
cell_types: Naive CD4 T cells, Naive T cells
metagene_label: Diffuse nuclear housekeeping background + Naive CD4 T cells

label: Class-switched memory B cells
description: Cluster 5 is a B-lineage cluster: M50 (class-switched/memory B cell program, MS4A1, CD79A, BANK1, IGHA1, IGHG1, TNFRSF13B) carries 20% of counts in 91% of cells, and the top genes (MS4A1, CD79A/B, BANK1, BLK, TNFRSF13C, POU2AF1, IRF8, IGHA1, IGHG1, TNFRSF13B) are B-lineage with strong fold enrichment. M2 (naive B markers IGHM, IGHD, FCER2, TCL1A) and M53 (B add-on, FCRL5/IGHG3) support B identity; the cluster leans toward switched memory B cells, with some plasmablast-like signal from JCHAIN and IGHA1. Remaining metagenes (M0, M20, M4, M28, M45, M62, M73, M58) are diffuse background or stress/IEG signals and mitochondrial/technical factors without lineage content; M80 NF-kB and M22/M25 stress programs are weak. No meaningful foreign lineage contamination.
cell_types: Class-switched memory B cells, Memory B cells, Naive B cells
metagene_label: Class-switched memory B cells + Diffuse nuclear housekeeping background

label: Naive B cells
description: Cluster 6 is a large naive B cell population: M2 (Naive B cell markers) carries 30.4% of counts in all cells at 59x enrichment, and top genes IGHM, IGHD, MS4A1, CD79A, PAX5, TCL1A, FCER2, FCRL1, CD22 and BANK1 confirm the B lineage with no T or myeloid markers. M4 (quiescence program, shared T/B naive state) and M53 (B cell add-on with class-switched IGHG3/FCRL5 signal, highest in cluster 7) are consistent with B cell states. Diffuse background (M0, M28, M38) and stress/IEG programs (M73, M25, M9, M80, M22, M6) are weak and lineage-neutral.
cell_types: Naive B cells
metagene_label: Naive B cell markers + Naive lymphocyte quiescence program

label: Class-switched memory B cells, FCRL5/IGHG3-high
description: Cluster 7 is a B cell cluster: M53 (B-cell add-on, FCRL5/IGHG3-high, medium confidence) carries 31% of counts in nearly all cells, and M2 (naive B cell markers, IGHM/IGHD/FCER2/TCL1A/PAX5) adds a further 9.9% in about half the cells, with top genes MS4A1, CD79A, CD72, FCRL5, FCRL3, IGHM, IGHD and CD74 all strongly enriched. M50 (class-switched memory B) adds 3.8%, suggesting a mix of naive and memory/class-switched B cells with some state and immediate-early signal (KLF2, JUND). The remaining metagenes (M0, M20, M58, M12, M38, M35, M88) are diffuse background or mitochondrial factors with no contamination from another lineage.
cell_types: B cells, Memory B cells, Naive B cells
metagene_label: B cell add-on, FCRL5/IGHG3-high + Diffuse nuclear housekeeping background
refine_reason: Same identity as cluster 5 (class-switched memory B cells). The dominant FCRL5/IGHG3-high add-on program (M53, 31%) is a clear state difference, so it is stated as a qualifier.

label: Classical monocytes (immediate-early high)
description: Cluster 8 is dominated by classical monocyte signal: M1 (S100A9, LYZ, S100A8, VCAN, CD14, 25.7% share in 73% of cells) plus M5 (classical monocytes with immediate-early/stress add-on, FOS/JUNB/DUSP1/KLF4, 15.6%) and M46 (myeloid core: LYZ, CD14, CTSS, SPI1, MPEG1, 9.1%). Top genes (S100A9, LYZ, S100A8, VCAN, CD14, CSF3R) confirm a monocyte identity. Its largest M1 and M46 shares are in cluster 9, which is a sign of a related myeloid cluster. Minor DC (M77, CLEC10A, 4.4%) and inflammatory (M98) signals are small; the stress and IEG metagenes are diffuse add-ons and the interferon program is minor.
cell_types: Classical monocytes, Monocytes
metagene_label: Classical monocyte markers + Classical monocytes, immediate early-high

label: Classical monocytes
description: Cluster 9 is a classical monocyte population: M1 (classical monocyte markers, S100A9, LYZ, S100A8, VCAN, CD14) carries 31% of counts in 87% of cells at 11x enrichment, and the top genes (LYZ, S100A9, S100A8, VCAN, CD14, CST3, FGL2, MPEG1) confirm the myeloid monocyte identity. M46 (monocyte/macrophage markers, 13%, 11.7x) adds core myeloid signal, and M77 (CLEC10A-high DC, 9%) shows some monocyte-DC mixing, though its CD1C-poor profile makes a DC call weak. Diffuse background factors (M0, M7, M15, M40, M28, M13) are low-specificity and not lineage-informative; M8 suggests a small FCGR3A-high non-classical subset within the monocyte lineage.
cell_types: Classical monocytes, Monocytes
metagene_label: Classical monocyte markers + Monocyte/macrophage markers

label: Dendritic cells (CLEC10A-high, cDC2-like)
description: Cluster 10 is dominated by M77 (40.9% of counts, present in 99.4% of cells, 49x enriched), which carries CLEC10A, FCER1A, CD1D and CIITA alongside CD74, LYZ and CST3, the top genes by enrichment. This points to a dendritic cell population, most likely cDC2-like, though CD1C is weak here. Monocyte genes (M1 classical monocyte markers, 2.8% share, 0.8x fold) are not enriched, so monocyte mixing is minor. The diffuse housekeeping factors M0, M11, M15 and M7 are non-lineage background. There is no meaningful pDC (M16) or other lineage contamination.
cell_types: Dendritic cells (cDC2-like), Dendritic cells, Monocytes
metagene_label: Dendritic cells, CLEC10A-high + Diffuse nuclear housekeeping background

label: Classical monocytes (inflammatory response-high)
description: Classical monocytes with a strong acute inflammatory activation state. M1 (classical monocyte markers S100A9, LYZ, S100A8, VCAN, CD14) carries 21.9% of counts, and M46 (monocyte/macrophage markers LYZ, CD14, SPI1, CYBB) adds 11.2%. M98 (NFKBIA, CXCL8, IL1B, CCL3, TNF, G0S2) is the largest share at 17.7% and is present in 90.7% of cells, so the cluster is in an ex vivo or dissociation-activated state. The top genes (CXCL8, IL1B, G0S2, CCL3, NFKBIA, LYZ, S100A9) agree. Minor dendritic cell (M77) and immediate-early signals are below 5% and are not treated as contamination.
cell_types: Classical monocytes, Activated monocytes
metagene_label: Classical monocyte markers + Activated myeloid inflammatory response
refine_reason: Classical monocytes with a large inflammatory-response program (M98, 17.7%). Reworded to the same 'Classical monocytes, qualifier' pattern used by clusters 8 and 9 rather than a separate 'Activated' identity wording.

label: Non-classical monocytes (FCGR3A+)
description: Cluster 12 is non-classical (CD16+, FCGR3A-high) monocytes. M8 carries 43.8% of modeled counts and is present in 100% of cells, with top genes CDKN1C, FCGR3A, MS4A7, LST1, CSF1R and LILRB2, all strongly enriched in the top gene list (MS4A7 29.6x, LILRB2 15.9x, LST1 18.8x). Supporting monocyte-lineage signal comes from M46 (LYZ, CD14, CTSS, SPI1) at 3.3%. Diffuse background factors (M7, M0, M28, M38) and stress programs carry the rest and do not define identity. Minor dendritic-cell signal (M77, 1.8%) is too small to count as contamination.
cell_types: Non-classical monocytes, Monocytes
metagene_label: Non-classical monocytes (FCGR3A/CDKN1C) + ACTB/VIM/TMSB4X-high

label: CD4 T cells (naive/central memory-like)
description: Cluster 13 is a large CD4 T-cell cluster (about 11% of cells) with a naive/central-memory-like profile. The CD4 identity rests on M14 (CD4 T cell markers, IL7R, LTB, CD3E, CD4, TCF7, GATA3, CCR4, CD40LG; 13.5x enriched) with support from M59 (T cell markers, TRAC, CD5, ZAP70, BCL11B), M30 (CCR4/GATA3/MAF CD4 memory-like state) and M86 (CD28/CTLA4/CD4 add-on state). Top genes IL7R, LTB, TRAC, CD5, CCR4, CD28, GATA3 and CD4 confirm a T-helper profile. Diffuse background M0 and M20 are non-specific and no foreign lineage stands out. Naive markers CCR7 and SELL are weak here, so the call leans toward a CD4 subset of mixed naive and memory-like cells rather than a sharply naive population.
cell_types: CD4 T cells, Naive CD4 T cells, Memory CD4 T cells
metagene_label: Diffuse nuclear housekeeping background + CD4 T cell markers

label: CD4 T cells
description: Cluster 14 is a CD4 helper T-cell cluster, carrying the lineage signal from M14 (CD4 T markers: IL7R, LTB, CD3E, CD4, TCF7, GATA3, CD40LG), M86 (CD4 CTLA4/CD28 state) and M56 (naive T markers: TCF7, LEF1, CD28, BCL11B, CD5). Pan-T factors M10 (IL32, CD2, CD5, CD6, THEMIS) and M59 (TRAC, ZAP70, BCL11B) support it, and the top genes (IL7R, IL32, CD5, CD6, MAF, GATA3, CD40LG, TNFRSF25) agree. The largest share is diffuse housekeeping background (M0), and the signal is modest overall. A small MAIT-like component (M29, KLRB1, RORC) is present but too small to change the call.
cell_types: CD4 T cells, Memory CD4 T cells, Naive CD4 T cells
metagene_label: Diffuse nuclear housekeeping background + CD4 T cell markers

label: T cells (mixed CD4 and CD8 memory)
description: Cluster 15 is a T-cell cluster with a mixed CD4/CD8 composition. Pan-T markers (M61: TRAC, CD3E, CD3D, CD2) and the T-cell factor M59 carry the lineage signal, and TRBC2 is the top gene. The CD8 effector-memory program (M48: GZMK, CCL5, GZMA, EOMES) and the CD4 subsets (M86 CTLA4/CD28-high, M30 CCR4+ memory, M56 naive-like) add subset structure, and a small Treg module (M39: FOXP3, IL2RA, CTLA4) is present in a few cells. Diffuse housekeeping and cytoskeletal metagenes (M0, M11, M58, M45) carry much of the share but are not lineage-specific and are ignored.
cell_types: T cells, CD8 effector memory T cells, CD4 memory T cells
metagene_label: Diffuse nuclear housekeeping background + GZMK-high CD8 effector memory T cells

label: Regulatory T cells (CD4 memory-like)
description: Cluster 16 is dominated by regulatory CD4+ T cell signal: M39 (Treg identity: FOXP3, IL2RA, CTLA4, TIGIT, IKZF2, RTKN2) carries 11.7% of counts at 59.7x enrichment and is present in 55% of cells, with top genes FOXP3, RTKN2, CTLA4, IL2RA, TIGIT and IKZF2 strongly enriched. M30 (CCR4/GATA3/MAF CD4 memory-like helper signal, 6.0%, 12.5x) and M86 (CD4 CTLA4/CD28 state) add CD4 T-cell support, and pan-T metagenes (M19, M42, M59, M94) are weak and diffuse. M0 (diffuse housekeeping background, 9.2%) and ACTB/TMSB4X-type metagenes are non-lineage background; no strong foreign lineage is seen, so no contamination is called.
cell_types: Regulatory T cells, CD4 T cells
metagene_label: Regulatory T cells (FOXP3/IL2RA) + Diffuse nuclear housekeeping background

label: Cytotoxic NK cells (CD56dim CD16+)
description: Cluster 17 is dominated by M3, a cytotoxic lymphocyte program (GNLY, NKG7, PRF1, GZMB, FGFBP2, KLRF1, SH2D1B, FCGR3A, KLRD1) present in all cells at 33% of counts and 20x enrichment, matching cytotoxic NK cells (CD56dim/CD16-high). Top genes confirm this (GNLY, PRF1, NKG7, FGFBP2, SPON2, KLRF1, FCGR3A, KLRD1), with some CD8/NKT-shared genes (CD247, CTSW, TRDC). The remaining metagenes (M0, M37, M90, M13, M35, M28, M92, M11) are diffuse, low-specificity background with no clear lineage, and M43 is a small ambiguous cytotoxic/stromal-like mixture at about 2%; no substantial foreign lineage contamination is evident. M93 (S-phase) is minor and not a defining feature.
cell_types: Cytotoxic NK cells, CD8 T cells, NKT-like cells
metagene_label: Cytotoxic NK cell markers + Diffuse nuclear housekeeping background

label: Cytotoxic NK cells
description: Cluster 18 is dominated by cytotoxic lymphocyte programs: M3 (cytotoxic NK markers, GNLY/NKG7/PRF1/GZMB/FGFBP2/KLRF1, 23% share, 6.8x enriched, present in 92% of cells) and M34 (NK markers with IL2RB/CTSW/KLRD1, 8% share, 13.8x enriched) together with top genes GNLY, NKG7, PRF1, IL2RB, KLRD1, KLRF1 and TRDC, pointing to NK cells. M74 (CD8 effector program, 2% share, few cells) and the diffuse factors M0, M90, M37, M28, M38 and M13 contribute little lineage-specific signal and no comparable second lineage, so no contamination is called. Some gamma-delta/NK-like T overlap is possible via TRDC and CD8A-linked metagenes, but NK identity is favored. Cluster 17 has the largest M3 share, so this cluster is a fairly typical NK population.
cell_types: NK cells, CD56dim CD16+ NK cells, Gamma-delta T cells
metagene_label: Cytotoxic NK cell markers + Diffuse nuclear housekeeping background

label: NK cells (with NK-like T signal)
description: Cluster 19 is dominated by M34 (30% of counts, present in 98% of cells, fold 51x), a cytotoxic lymphocyte program led by GNLY, NKG7, CTSW, KLRD1, KLRF1, NCAM1, KLRC1, IL2RB and IL18RAP, pointing to NK cells. Some gamma-delta or NK-like T signal is present (TRDC, CD7, CD2, ZAP70, SELL), so the cluster may include NK-like T or gamma-delta T cells. M3 (cytotoxic NK markers) is weak here (fold 0.5x, largest in cluster 17), so it does not add much. The remaining metagenes (M0, M38, M60, M51, M13, M76, M96) are diffuse housekeeping or lymphocyte-leaning background with no clear lineage, and M85 (CD34 progenitor, fold 10x, largest in cluster 28) and M80 (NF-kB program) are minor and not enriched enough to matter. No meaningful foreign lineage contamination.
cell_types: NK cells, Gamma-delta T cells, NK-like T cells
metagene_label: NK cell markers + Diffuse nuclear housekeeping background

label: Cytotoxic NK cells (CD8 effector T overlap)
description: Cluster 20 is dominated by cytotoxic lymphocyte signal: M3 (Cytotoxic NK cell markers, 16.4% share, 4.2x enriched, in 81% of cells) and M26 (cytotoxic effector T/NK, 13.4%, 7.9x) carry GNLY, NKG7, PRF1, GZMB, GZMH, FGFBP2, KLRD1, CX3CR1 and SPON2, pointing to CD56dim/CD16-high NK cells with some terminal effector CD8 T overlap. M74 (CD8 cytotoxic effector T, 2.5%) adds CD8A and EOMES support for a CD8 effector component in a subset. Remaining metagenes (M0, M11, M37, M13, M28) are diffuse housekeeping/background with no lineage; M43 and M89 are minor and ambiguous or activation-like. No clear foreign lineage contamination.
cell_types: NK cells, CD8 effector T cells
metagene_label: Cytotoxic NK cell markers + Cytotoxic effector T/NK cells

label: CD8 cytotoxic effector T cells
description: Cluster 21 is a cytotoxic CD8 effector T cell population. M74 (CD8 cytotoxic effector T, 16.6x enriched) carries CD8A, EOMES, KLRG1, CTSW and NKG7, and CD8A is 5.7x enriched among the top genes. M26 (cytotoxic effector T/NK, 8x) adds a shared cytotoxic axis (NKG7, GNLY, CCL5, PRF1, GZMH), and M32 gives a modest T-lineage signal (CD2, CD3E, CD247). M3 (NK markers) is not enriched here (1.1x), so NK-like overlap is minor and the CD8 T identity is favored. Diffuse background factors (M0, M11, M13, M38, M92) are not lineage signals. No clear foreign lineage contamination.
cell_types: CD8 effector T cells, NK cells
metagene_label: Cytotoxic effector T/NK cells + CD8 cytotoxic effector T cells

label: CD8 cytotoxic effector T cells
description: Cluster 22 is dominated by M26, a cytotoxic effector program (NKG7, GNLY, CCL5, PRF1, GZMH, CD8A, FGFBP2, CX3CR1) present in nearly all cells at 19.5% share and 16x enrichment, with M74 (CD8 cytotoxic effector T cells; NKG7, CTSW, CD8A, EOMES, KLRK1) and the top genes GZMH, CD8A, CCL5 supporting a CD8 effector T cell identity, while NK contribution (GNLY, KLRD1, FCGR3A-type signal) cannot be fully excluded. M10, M32 and M94 add a weak T-cell lineage background (CD2, CD3E, IL32, CD5, CD6) at low share. M0 (diffuse housekeeping background, 10%) and several diffuse low-specificity factors (M11, M37, M76, M60, M13) are not lineage-informative. M43 (PTGDS/FGFBP2) is a small, ambiguous subset signal in few cells and is not a contaminant call.
cell_types: CD8 effector T cells, NK cells, Cytotoxic T/NK cells
metagene_label: Cytotoxic effector T/NK cells + Diffuse nuclear housekeeping background

label: GZMK-high CD8 effector memory T cells
description: Cluster 23 is dominated by CD8 T-cell signal: M48 (GZMK-high CD8 effector memory, 20.5x enriched, present in 13.6% of cells) and M74 (cytotoxic CD8 effector program, 8.6x, 29% of cells), with CCL5, GZMK, CD8A, EOMES, KLRK1 and KLRG1 among the top genes. Naive CD8 (M69) and general T-cell markers (M10) are weak, and NK/cytotoxic M26 is only modestly enriched (1.1x), so the identity is CD8 memory/effector T cells rather than NK. The remaining metagenes (M0, M23, M13, M11) are diffuse housekeeping/stress background with no lineage, and M89 is a mild immediate-early activation program. No clear contaminating lineage.
cell_types: GZMK-high CD8 effector memory T cells, CD8 cytotoxic effector T cells, CD8 T cells
metagene_label: Diffuse nuclear housekeeping background + CD8 cytotoxic effector T cells

label: Plasmacytoid dendritic cells
description: Cluster 24 is dominated by the pDC program M16 (56.1% of counts, present in all cells, >100x enriched), supported by top genes CLEC4C, LILRA4, PLD4, PTPRS, IL3RA, JCHAIN, IRF7, TCF4 and SERPINF1, with IRF8 also high. Myeloid cDC2 (CD1C, CLEC10A) and monocyte (LYZ, CD14) markers are absent, so this is a plasmacytoid dendritic cell cluster. The remaining signal is diffuse housekeeping background (M0, M47, M28, M65, M63) with no lineage, and a small CD34+ progenitor factor M85 (0.9%, in <0.1% of cells) is negligible. No meaningful contamination is evident.
cell_types: Plasmacytoid dendritic cells
metagene_label: pDC markers + Diffuse nuclear housekeeping background

label: Cytotoxic effector CD8 T/NK cells
description: Cluster 25 is dominated by M26 (15.9% of counts, enriched 9x, present in 89% of cells), a cytotoxic effector program (NKG7, GNLY, CCL5, PRF1, GZMH, GZMA, GZMB, CST7, KLRD1, CD8A, FGFBP2, CX3CR1) that fits terminal effector CD8 T and NK cells; CD3E is weak, so T versus NK cannot be fully separated. Supporting T-lineage metagenes (M10 IL32/CD2/CD5/CD6, M32 CD2/CD3E/BCL11B/CD247, M94 resting T signature) are present at modest shares, and top genes include CD8A, CD2, IL32, THEMIS and RORA, consistent with a CD8 T-cell-leaning effector population. Remaining metagenes (M0, M11, M37, M76, M72, M13) are diffuse housekeeping or background with no lineage and are ignored; M89 is an immediate-early activation program, not a lineage.
cell_types: Cytotoxic CD8 T cells, NK cells, Effector T cells
metagene_label: Cytotoxic effector T/NK cells + Diffuse nuclear housekeeping background

label: MAIT-like innate-like T cells
description: Cluster 26 is an innate-like T cell population with a MAIT-like profile. M29 carries 12.9% of counts and is enriched 41.6-fold, present in 58.7% of cells, with RORC, SLC4A10, RORA, KLRB1, IL7R, CXCR6, NCR3 and CCR5 among the top genes (KLRB1 11.7x, CCR5 10.8x, RORA 3.1x). ZBTB16 and CCR6 are weak and TRAV1-2 is unmeasured, so the MAIT call is not fully confirmed. M48 (GZMK-high CD8 effector memory, CCL5/GZMK/CD8A) and M10 (generic T-cell memory) support a T lineage, and M26 (cytotoxic effector) is modest. M0, M13, M28 and M78 are diffuse background factors with no lineage, and M89 is an activation/immediate-early response. No significant foreign lineage is present.
cell_types: MAIT cells, CD8 effector memory T cells, NK-like T cells
metagene_label: MAIT-like T cells + Diffuse nuclear housekeeping background

label: Platelets/megakaryocytes
description: Cluster 27 is a small platelet/megakaryocyte cluster (386 cells, 0.2%). M31 (platelet/megakaryocyte genes: PPBP, PF4, TUBB1, ITGA2B, GP1BB, CAVIN2) carries 82% of modeled counts and is present in all cells, with the top genes PPBP, NRGN, CAVIN2, TUBB1, ITGB3, GP1BB, ITGA2B, PF4 and GNG11 all strongly enriched (>100x). Remaining metagenes (M0, M25, M1, M85, M11, M7, M12, M8) are each below 2.5% and largely diffuse or technical; M1 and M8 monocyte signals are weak and do not compete with the platelet identity, so they are at most minor spillover and not listed as contaminants. Platelet-lineage signal dominates, consistent with platelet contamination or platelet-leukocyte doublets in a PBMC dataset.
cell_types: Platelets, Megakaryocytes
metagene_label: Platelet/megakaryocyte genes + Diffuse nuclear housekeeping background

label: CD34+ hematopoietic progenitor cells (+ B cell signal)
description: Cluster 28 is a rare CD34+ hematopoietic progenitor population. M85 carries 27.8% of counts and is present in 52% of cells at >100x fold, with top genes SOX4, NREP, MYB, SPINK2, MEX3B, HOXA9, GATA2 and CD34. Mature lineage markers are absent. M50 (class-switched/memory B-cell program: MS4A1, CD79A, IGHA1, IGHG1, JCHAIN) contributes 9.2% of counts in 26% of cells, a moderate foreign signal that is likely B-cell contamination or doublets. Diffuse background factors (M0, M65, M47, M45) add no identity. Platelet and pDC signals are minor and mostly come from other clusters.
cell_types: CD34+ hematopoietic progenitor cells, Hematopoietic stem/progenitor cells
metagene_label: CD34+ progenitor cells + Diffuse nuclear housekeeping background
